content.short: Anycraft is a Telegram alchemy game where players combine items, craft creations, and turn them into NFTs.
content.description: Anycraft is an AI-powered crafting game built for Telegram. Its site describes combining items to craft new creations, earning from play, turning creations into NFTs, and trading those digital items with other players. The game is about creative item discovery and ownership rather than a simple tap counter. AI-Powered Alchemy game where you can craft anything!. Turn your creations into NFTs and trade your magical masterpieces with the world. That shows up in features such as fun made easy and roadmap.
